review_method: Direct inspection of four rendered section screenshots after focused browser checks.
observations: Edition comparison uses a two-row table on desktop and labeled stacked cards on mobile.
Message-family differences, accounting limitations and finite replay scope remain visible at both widths.
Download buttons, recipe command and expected result are legible, with no clipping or overlap in the inspected sections.
scope: Visual review of these rendered sections only. Automated browser checks separately cover 320, 390 and 1440 widths with JavaScript enabled and disabled; this is not a complete accessibility certification.
